author: Worldly_Way_4220
body: Moscow Deli on Harbor in Costa Mesa. Two tables in a Russian deli. Their sandwiches are amazing. Generous and delicious.

author: wizzard419
body:
Ooohh... Yeah so Moscow Deli is more the "safe" food, authentic Russian stuff can be less favorable to Americans.

Don't get too hung up on this, but try to find new cuisines and such.

Another examples is "Mexican" food, lots of places are tex-mex rather than true mex.
